# Renewal Order Form: Quillfeather Outfitters 2026

**Draft Date:** 2026-07-27  
**Execution Date:** 2026-08-10  
**Effective Date:** 2026-08-15  

**1. Parties and Scope**  
This Renewal Order Form ("Order Form") is entered into between Pemberline Systems ("Provider") and Quillfeather Outfitters ("Customer"). This Order Form amends and supersedes the commercial terms of the prior agreement between the parties governing Customer's access to Pemberline Dock at Customer's Bozeman distribution center (West Gate 3 through West Gate 8).

**2. Renewal Term**  
The renewal subscription period commences on the Effective Date of 2026-08-15 and continues through the end of the current term on 2027-08-14 ("Renewal Date"), despite this Order Form being executed on 2026-08-10.

**3. Subscription Fees**  
During the Renewal Term, the subscription fee for Pemberline Dock shall be USD 1,740 per seat per year. All other terms of the prior agreement not expressly modified herein remain in full force and effect.

**4. Execution**  
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Order Form on 2026-08-10.

**Quillfeather Outfitters**  
Signature: */s/ Harlan Vance*  
Name: Harlan Vance  
Title: Director of Supply Chain Operations  
Date: 2026-08-10  

**Pemberline Systems**  
Signature: */s/ June Osei-Lark*
